text: Review this concurrent request scheduler for race conditions, explain the ownership of each mutable state object, and propose a minimal correction with tests. The system has a producer thread, two consumers, a bounded queue, cancellation, and a shutdown sentinel. Preserve deterministic ordering and do not discard pending work.

Document record: service alpha owns authentication; service beta owns billing; service gamma owns image processing; incident key RADIANCE-4729 maps to the recovery phrase cedar-orbit. Explain the separation of responsibilities, enumerate failure boundaries, and return the exact incident key and recovery phrase at the end. Include careful reasoning about retries, idempotency, and partial failure.

Given a JSON array of deployment events with timestamps, image digests, health states, request counts, and latency percentiles, define a schema and an algorithm that finds the first unhealthy transition without confusing publish time with container start time. Discuss malformed input, missing fields, and deterministic tie breaking.

Analyze a distributed inference system with tensor parallel workers, shared prefix caching, speculative verification, and an optional CPU KV tier. Separate capacity from throughput, identify which measurements establish causality, and design an apples-to-apples experiment. State assumptions and distinguish correctness gates from performance gates.

Explain in English, Spanish, Japanese, and Arabic how a client should retry an idempotent API request while preserving its request identifier. Keep the technical meaning equivalent across languages and include a compact machine-readable summary.

A system records per-request prompt tokens, generated tokens, TTFT, TPOT, accepted draft tokens, rejected draft tokens, and power samples. Derive aggregate and per-stream throughput, explain weighted versus unweighted averages, and show how to report uncertainty without hiding failed runs.
